title: Tomato Basil Grilled Cheese
description: Crisp buttery bread with gooey cheese, tomato, and a little basil.
substitutions: Dried basil works in a pinch.

steps.text: Butter the outside of both bread slices with 1 tablespoon butter.
Layer cheese, tomato, and basil between the unbuttered sides.
Cook in a skillet over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes per side, pressing gently, until golden and the cheese is melted.

storage: Refrigerate leftovers promptly and use within 3–4 days.

title: Black Bean Quesadillas
description: Crispy tortillas filled with seasoned black beans and melted cheese.
substitutions: Add leftover corn or salsa if available.

steps.text: Mash 1 cup black beans lightly with 1/2 teaspoon cumin.
Divide beans and 1 cup cheese between 2 tortillas; top with the remaining tortillas.
Heat 1 teaspoon oil in a skillet and cook each quesadilla 2–3 minutes per side until crisp and melted. Cut into wedges.

title: Creamy Tomato Tortellini
description: Refrigerated tortellini simmered in a quick creamy tomato sauce.
substitutions: Frozen tortellini works; add a few extra minutes.
Milk plus 1 tablespoon cream cheese can replace cream.

steps.text: Put tomato sauce, 1/2 cup cream, and Italian seasoning in a large skillet; bring to a gentle simmer.
Add 20 ounces tortellini, cover, and simmer 8–10 minutes, stirring once or twice, until tender.
Stir in 1/4 cup Parmesan and serve.

title: Sheet-Pan Chicken Fajitas
description: Chicken strips, peppers, and onions roasted together for easy fajitas.

ingredients.item: boneless chicken breast or thighs, sliced

substitutions: Use frozen pepper-and-onion strips to cut prep.
Serve over rice instead of tortillas.

steps.text: Toss chicken, peppers, onion, 2 tablespoons oil, chili powder, and cumin on a sheet pan.
Roast for 20–22 minutes, stirring once, until the chicken is cooked through and vegetables are tender.
Warm tortillas and fill with the chicken and vegetables.
